### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the Gemini tool-use token accounting correction. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes Gemini token accounting so content fetched by built-in tools contributes to input-token totals and cost estimates for `ChatGoogle()` and `ChatVertex()`. **Changes:** - Includes `tool_use_prompt_token_count` in input tokens while preserving cached-token subtraction. - Adds regression tests for tool-use tokens and unchanged cached-token behavior. - Documents the correction in the changelog. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​test_provider_google.py` | Adds tests for tool-use input tokens and cached-token accounting. | | `chatlas/​_provider_google.py` | Includes tool-use prompt tokens in input-token totals. | | `CHANGELOG.md` | Documents corrected token totals and cost estimates. |
Review effort: Balanced
